notes: Third-party notices copied into each packaged program's licenses/ directory by tools/package_programs.py.

Paths are relative to programs/ unless prefixed with $GUI_FORMS_SDK (the prebuilt GUI.Forms SDK's share/licenses/GUIForms, which carries GUI.Forms' licence and notices and every stx and STXlib licence under the names it installs them; package_programs.py --sdk names the SDK), $GUI_FORMS_LLVM_RUNTIME (macOS runtime prefix) or $MSYS_PREFIX (the Windows toolchain prefix). In gui_forms_devkit no GUI.Forms or stx checkout is read.
optional=true entries are skipped with a log line when the file is absent (fetched dependencies, platform runtimes); the others fail the package.

Windows binaries are built on STXlib's own runtime (tools/own_runtime.py) and link libc++ 22.1.8 statically, beside STXlib's startup, C++ runtime and import libraries (STXlib's licence); the C runtime is the system's ucrtbase.dll. libc++'s licence is the checked-in packaging/licenses/llvm notice, shipped although the LLVM exception does not require it for embedded runtime code.

Linux binaries link libc++ 22, libc++abi and libunwind statically (cmake/llvm22.cmake), as Windows binaries link their runtimes; tools/package_programs.py refuses a Linux package that still needs one as a shared library. Their licences are the checked-in packaging/licenses/llvm notices.

component names the row of THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md that covers the file; tools/package_programs.py checks every package against that file. One entry per line, so adding or removing a component is a one-line edit here and one row there.
